name: Leaf Octree for Iso Mesh
definition: A compact spatial data structure for storing iso-surface mesh elements (quads and points) in a leaf node of an octree, using a 30-bit index and 1-bit flags per node entry.
summary: Leaf Octree is a compact spatial data structure storing iso-surface mesh primitives in octree leaves, distinguished by packing node metadata into a single 32-bit word to minimize memory overhead.
